package.name: minddrive_f1tenth
package.description: Real-world MindDrive deployment on an F1TENTH car: one camera on the Jetson AGX Orin feeding MindDrive's six camera slots (front three from the camera, rear three black), pose / speed / global path from the F1TENTH stack on the Jetson Nano, MindDrive inference on the Orin with the minddrive_ros speedups (fast / int8 / lite profiles), and simlingo_f1tenth's trajectory controller driving the Nano's /drive topic.
